# HTTP API reference

<!-- Generated by `go run ./tools/docgen`. Do not edit by hand: change the code and regenerate. -->

Every route the server exposes. Routes marked **public** need no sign-in; all others need a session cookie or an `X-API-Key` header (see the Profile page). Routes marked **any account** work for members and administrators; routes marked **admin** answer members with 403 `{"error": "Only an administrator can do this."}` (see [accounts.md](../accounts.md)). Responses are JSON; errors are `{"error": "..."}`.
